card.name: Words just before place names
card.fires_on: Small linking words, spaces or digits where a place or region name (especially African or Asian) is expected next, such as 'of' before Eastern Madagascar or 'north of' a river. It also fires on a few unrelated spots inside dates, numbers and drug names.

modes.label: Linking word before a place
modes.description: A word like 'of', 'to' or 'through' in a geographic description, right before a place name.
